articles.title: Best Friend or Killer? 18-Year Friendship Ends Over ₹5 Lakh Gold Chain in Shocking Murder
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An 18-year-old friendship ended in a shocking murder after a computer coaching institute owner was allegedly killed by his best friend over a gold chain worth ₹5 lakh.

body.html:
An 18-year-old friendship ended in a shocking murder after a computer coaching institute owner was allegedly killed by his best friend over a gold chain worth ₹5 lakh.

According to the investigation, accused Mohit Dwivedi meticulously planned the crime by watching YouTube tutorials and disguising himself in a burqa. However, his unusual walking style captured on CCTV footage ultimately led police to him.

The incident took place on the night of May 31 during the IPL final. Knowing that Prakash Chandra Gupta would be staying overnight at his coaching institute to watch the match, Mohit allegedly arrived wearing a burqa and women's footwear to conceal his identity.

Police said a violent struggle broke out inside the room when Mohit allegedly tried to snatch the heavy gold chain from an intoxicated Prakash. During the scuffle, Prakash was forcefully pushed, causing him to fall and suffer fatal head injuries.

Mohit allegedly fled the scene with the gold chain and a gold bracelet, leaving his friend bleeding to death.

The next morning, Prakash's family found his body lying in a pool of blood. Investigators initially suspected an accidental fall caused by a medical emergency, but the missing jewellery prompted a full-fledged murder investigation.

After multiple teams failed to crack the case, senior Kanpur police officer Raghubir Lal reviewed CCTV footage and noticed a burqa-clad person whose masculine gait raised suspicion.

Police tracked the suspect across nearly 100 CCTV cameras, eventually tracing the individual to a car where Mohit had allegedly changed into the disguise, leading to his arrest.

Investigators also revealed that Mohit appeared highly confident of escaping suspicion. On the morning after the murder, he reportedly mingled with the victim's grieving family and casually interacted with police officers at the crime scene. He later appeared for a competitive teaching examination and travelled to Lucknow the following day.

The victim's family remains devastated by the alleged betrayal.

"We never expected Mohit to do this," said Prakash's brother, Vikas. "He destroyed an 18-year-old friendship out of pure greed. He was my only brother; who can we ever trust now?"

#BestFriendMurder #KanpurCrime #CrimeNews #MurderCase #ShockingCrime

articles.title: Viral Video Shows Tusker Charging at Biker': Rider Escapes by Seconds After Risky Move Near Munnar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A two-wheeler rider had a narrow escape after a wild elephant charged at him on the Munnar-Udumalpet National Highway on Wednesday morning. According to officials, the incident occurred at the S-Valavu (S-Curve) bend near the Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border.

body.html:
A two-wheeler rider had a narrow escape after a wild elephant charged at him on the Munnar-Udumalpet National Highway on Wednesday morning.

According to officials, the incident occurred at the S-Valavu (S-Curve) bend near the Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border.

A wild tusker, locally known as Virikompan, was standing in the middle of the road. On spotting the animal, other motorists safely stopped their vehicles on the roadside and waited for it to move into the forest. However, a two-wheeler rider attempted to pass along the edge of the road.

The moving vehicle caught the tusker's attention, prompting it to suddenly charge at the rider. The biker quickly swerved to the side of the road, abandoned the vehicle and ran to safety, narrowly escaping the attack.

The dramatic encounter was captured on video by passengers travelling in a bus, and the footage has since gone viral on social media.

An official from the Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary clarified that the incident did not occur within the sanctuary's jurisdiction. The S-Valavu area falls under the Anamalai Tiger Reserve in neighbouring Tamil Nadu.

"Normally, wild elephants in the Chinnar region do not attack vehicles. The Forest department conducts regular night patrolling along this route to ensure the safety of both people and wildlife," the official said.

According to Forest department sources, the two-wheeler rider's reckless attempt to pass the elephant allegedly provoked the animal, triggering the aggressive charge.

articles.title: Man Arrested After Allegedly Attacking Wife, Fleeing With Son
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 38-year-old man was arrested near Thanjavur on Thursday after allegedly attacking his wife over a suspected extramarital affair and fleeing with their five-year-old son. He later posted disturbing videos on Instagram in which he spoke about killing his son and himself. The accused, P.

body.html:
A 38-year-old man was arrested near Thanjavur on Thursday after allegedly attacking his wife over a suspected extramarital affair and fleeing with their five-year-old son. He later posted disturbing videos on Instagram in which he spoke about killing his son and himself.

The accused, P. Dharmaraj, a resident of Mayilpalayam in Pattukkottai, was arrested following an intensive search operation. His wife sustained critical injuries and is undergoing treatment at Thanjavur Medical College Hospital.

According to police, Dharmaraj and his wife have been married for six years. While the couple was living in Trichy last year, Dharmaraj allegedly found his wife with another man at their house. A heated argument followed, after which the couple began living separately.

Police said the couple reconciled a few days ago, and Dharmaraj moved back with his wife to Pattukkottai. However, on Wednesday, he allegedly attacked her with a sharp weapon at their residence.

After the assault, Dharmaraj allegedly took their son and went into hiding. He then uploaded a video clip on Instagram, reportedly recorded a year earlier, which allegedly showed his wife with another man. He also posted new videos of himself covered in blood and speaking about ending his life along with his son.

The videos triggered widespread alarm on social media, prompting police to launch a massive search operation.

Acting on a tip-off, a special police team apprehended Dharmaraj near Thanjavur on Thursday evening. The child was rescued safely and placed in a children's home.

Pattukkottai police registered a case against Dharmaraj under Sections 296B, 118(1), 351(3) and 74 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). He was produced before a magistrate and remanded to Thanjavur Sub Jail.

Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: House of Cards' Collapse Caught on Camera: Four-Storey Delhi Building Crashes Down Hours After Cra
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major tragedy was averted in northeast Delhi's Karawal Nagar area on Tuesday evening after a four-storey building in Prakash Vihar suddenly collapsed hours after developing structural cracks.

body.html:
A major tragedy was averted in northeast Delhi's Karawal Nagar area on Tuesday evening after a four-storey building in Prakash Vihar suddenly collapsed hours after developing structural cracks. Authorities confirmed that the building had been evacuated in time, preventing any loss of life or injuries.

According to police, the Karawal Nagar Police Station received information about the collapse of a house in Gali No. 2, Prakash Vihar, at around 6:38 pm on June 3, 2026. Police personnel, firefighters, the District Disaster Management Authority (DDMA) and other emergency agencies immediately rushed to the spot.

Northeast Delhi Deputy Commissioner of Police Rahul Ahlawat said preliminary findings suggest that drain construction and repair work was being carried out near the building by a concerned civic department from Uttar Pradesh. Around 3 pm on Tuesday, visible cracks began appearing in the structure. Sensing danger, authorities and local residents evacuated the building as a precautionary measure.

A few hours later, the entire building came crashing down, triggering panic in the neighbourhood. Residents rushed out of their homes as dust and debris engulfed the area.

Following the incident, police cordoned off the site and tightened security arrangements. Officials are investigating whether the nearby drain construction work played a role in weakening the structure. Agencies are examining the debris and inspecting adjacent buildings as a precaution.

DCP Ahlawat said rescue and safety measures are being carried out by the fire department, DDMA and other agencies, while a detailed investigation into the cause of the collapse remains underway.

Meanwhile, a dramatic video of the incident has gone viral on social media, showing the four-storey building collapsing like a house of cards as people run to safety.

articles.title: Caught on CCTV?' Manali Harassment Video Triggers Massive Outrage, Police Launch Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video from the tourist town of Manali is rapidly going viral on social media, allegedly showing a foreign woman tourist being subjected to inappropriate behaviour by a young man on a public road. According to reports, the incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

body.html:
A video from the tourist town of Manali is rapidly going viral on social media, allegedly showing a foreign woman tourist being subjected to inappropriate behaviour by a young man on a public road.

According to reports, the incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. The viral footage purportedly shows the woman walking along the road when a young man passing by allegedly misbehaves with her. Authorities are currently verifying the authenticity of the video and the exact location where the incident took place.

Taking suo motu cognisance of the matter, the Manali police and local administration have launched an investigation, despite no formal complaint being filed so far.

Manali SDM Gunjeet Singh Cheema said the administration has taken the matter seriously and ordered a detailed probe. He stated that if the video is found to be authentic and the accused is identified, strict legal action will be taken in accordance with the law.

DSP Manali KD Sharma confirmed that the viral video has come to the notice of the police. He said that while no written complaint has been received from the victim or any other source, officials are thoroughly investigating the matter. A case will be registered and appropriate action initiated if a complaint is filed or the investigation establishes the facts.

The video has sparked widespread outrage on social media, with users demanding stringent action against the accused. Local residents have also expressed concern, stating that such incidents damage the image of Himachal Pradesh and could adversely affect tourism in the state.

#Manali #ViralVideo #TouristSafety #WomenSafety #HimachalPradesh #ForeignTourist

articles.title: Speeding SUV Ploughs Into Men Sitting Under Tree in Greater Noida, Two Seriously Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two men sustained serious injuries after a speeding SUV allegedly rammed into them while they were sitting under a tree in Greater Noida's Alpha-2 area under the Beta-2 police station limits.

body.html:
Two men sustained serious injuries after a speeding SUV allegedly rammed into them while they were sitting under a tree in Greater Noida's Alpha-2 area under the Beta-2 police station limits.

According to a complaint filed by Dankaur resident Manish Singhal, the incident took place at around 4:30 pm on Tuesday near Bikaner Sweets in Sector Alpha-2.

The victims, identified as Lalit and Khemchand, both residents of Dankaur, were sitting on chairs under a tree in a vacant plot when a speeding Ford Endeavour, allegedly being driven recklessly, struck them.

The force of the collision threw both men to the ground. The SUV then crashed into two parked cars nearby, causing additional damage.

Local residents rushed the injured men to Navin Hospital for treatment.

According to reports, Khemchand suffered fractured ribs, while Lalit sustained injuries to his arm, waist and spine. Doctors said both men are undergoing treatment and their condition is currently stable.

The complainant alleged that the occupants of the SUV appeared to be under the influence of alcohol. After the crash, they reportedly abandoned the vehicle and fled the scene.

Police have taken cognisance of the complaint and launched an investigation into the incident.

Alpha-2 outpost in-charge Ankit Kumar said the matter is being examined and investigators are collecting evidence. He added that both parties are currently engaged in discussions aimed at reaching a settlement.

Police said further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation and the outcome of the ongoing proceedings.

The incident has raised concerns over reckless driving and alleged drunk driving in busy urban areas, where such accidents can have devastating consequences for pedestrians and bystanders.

articles.title: Careless Car Door Opens, Seconds Later a Man Is Dead: CCTV Captures Fatal Firozabad Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 57-year-old man was killed and his son-in-law seriously injured in Uttar Pradesh's Firozabad after a motorcycle crashed into the door of a parked car that was allegedly opened suddenly without checking for oncoming traffic.

body.html:
A 57-year-old man was killed and his son-in-law seriously injured in Uttar Pradesh's Firozabad after a motorcycle crashed into the door of a parked car that was allegedly opened suddenly without checking for oncoming traffic.

The deceased has been identified as Hukam Singh (57), while the injured man, Pradeep Kumar (30), is currently undergoing treatment.

According to police and local sources, Hukam Singh and his son-in-law were travelling on a motorcycle and carrying a gas cylinder at the time of the incident. As they reached near Bodhashram in Firozabad, the driver of a car parked along the roadside allegedly opened the vehicle's door abruptly without ensuring the road was clear.

The motorcycle crashed directly into the open door, throwing both riders onto the road.

The impact left both men critically injured. Local residents rushed them to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared Hukam Singh dead. Pradeep Kumar, who sustained serious injuries, was later referred to a hospital in Agra for advanced treatment and remains under medical care.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed in the area. The footage, which has since gone viral on social media, reportedly shows the moment the car door was opened and the motorcycle colliding with it before the riders were thrown onto the road.

The video also allegedly shows the car driver and another individual inspecting the damaged vehicle door immediately after the crash, while the injured men remained lying on the road.

Police from North Police Station have launched an investigation into the incident. Officials said CCTV footage and other evidence collected from the scene are being examined, and further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

The incident has once again highlighted the dangers of opening vehicle doors without checking for approaching traffic, a common cause of road accidents in urban areas.

articles.title: ‘Just Because I’m Performing Doesn’t Mean You Can Touch Me’: Dancer Slaps Man On Stage in Hathras
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Haryanvi stage dancer Dimple Chaudhary was allegedly subjected to inappropriate behaviour during a live performance in Uttar Pradesh's Hathras district, prompting her to slap a man on stage and publicly confront him. Dimple also shared a video of the incident on her Instagram account.

body.html:
Haryanvi stage dancer Dimple Chaudhary was allegedly subjected to inappropriate behaviour during a live performance in Uttar Pradesh's Hathras district, prompting her to slap a man on stage and publicly confront him.

Dimple also shared a video of the incident on her Instagram account. The footage shows a young man approaching the stage and allegedly touching her waist while she was performing.

Reacting immediately, Dimple slapped the man and reprimanded him through the microphone in front of the audience.

"Just because a performance is going on doesn't mean you can touch me," she said while addressing the crowd.

According to Dimple, the incident took place on June 3 during a dance and Ragini programme organised to celebrate a girl's birthday in the Hathras area. The event began around 8 pm, while she took the stage at approximately 10 pm.

Several artists, including dancers and singers Shivani, Komal Chaudhary and others, were performing throughout the night.

Dimple said that around 2:30 am, while she was performing to the Haryanvi song 'Gandass', a young man climbed onto the stage. She alleged that the man, who was related to the event organiser, attempted to touch her inappropriately, leading to her immediate reaction.

Speaking about the incident, Dimple said stage performers work both to entertain audiences and to earn a livelihood, but that does not give anyone the right to disrespect their dignity.

She stated that inappropriate behaviour and harassment would not be tolerated under any circumstances. Dimple also acknowledged that she used some harsh language while confronting the man in the heat of the moment.

Despite the incident, she said she does not intend to file a police complaint, as she had already responded to the man's behaviour on the spot.

According to Dimple, the incident created a commotion at the venue, and sticks had to be used to control the crowd after tensions escalated.

Originally from Bulandshahr in Uttar Pradesh, Dimple Chaudhary began her career as a stage performer in 2018. She said financial difficulties led her to pursue performing as a profession. Although her family initially opposed the decision, they later supported her after witnessing her success.

She started by singing bhajans and devotional songs at jagrans before moving into stage performances. Dimple said she initially earned around ₹500 per programme and now charges up to ₹40,000 for a two-hour stage show.

Responding to criticism often directed at stage performers, she said her work is a means of supporting her family and that audiences continue to invite her because they enjoy her performances.

The video of the incident has since gone viral on social media, sparking discussions about the safety and dignity of performers during public events.

articles.title: Foot on Metro Window, Argument with Passengers Ends in Police Case and Fine in Hyderabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A passenger travelling on a Hyderabad Metro Rail service from Nagole to Raidurg was fined and booked after allegedly placing his foot on a metro window and refusing to stop despite objections from fellow passengers.

body.html:
A passenger travelling on a Hyderabad Metro Rail service from Nagole to Raidurg was fined and booked after allegedly placing his foot on a metro window and refusing to stop despite objections from fellow passengers.

According to Hyderabad Metro Rail officials, the incident took place on Monday while the passenger was travelling on the Nagole–Raidurg route. Several commuters reportedly objected to his behaviour and asked him to remove his foot from the window.

However, officials said the passenger allegedly argued with fellow travellers and insisted on continuing to sit in the same manner despite repeated objections.

A fellow commuter subsequently lodged a complaint with metro authorities, following which action was initiated.

The passenger was detained by police upon arrival at Raidurg Metro Station. A complaint was later filed at Raidurg Police Station, where a case was registered against him.

The individual was identified as Chaitanya.

Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited (HMRL) General Manager (Security) Srinath Reddy stated that a fine of ₹250 was imposed on the passenger under relevant provisions of the Metro Rail Act for violating public transport norms.

A video showing the passenger sitting with his foot resting on the metro window was widely circulated on social media, drawing criticism from commuters and members of the public.

Many social media users described the behaviour as lacking civic sense and called for stricter enforcement of rules to maintain discipline and cleanliness in public transport systems.

Metro authorities reiterated the importance of following passenger etiquette and complying with regulations to ensure a comfortable travel experience for everyone.

articles.title: CCTV Captures Bizarre Burglary: Thieves Drink Soft Drinks Before Stealing Gold, Silver and Cash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking theft has been reported from Kodada in Telangana's Suryapet district, where miscreants allegedly broke into a house while the owners were away and helped themselves to cool drinks before carrying out the burglary.

body.html:
A shocking theft has been reported from Kodada in Telangana's Suryapet district, where miscreants allegedly broke into a house while the owners were away and helped themselves to cool drinks before carrying out the burglary.

According to reports, Nagesh and Madhavi had travelled to Khammam when the accused allegedly entered their residence. CCTV footage reportedly shows the intruders inside the house during the incident.

The thieves allegedly escaped with around 60 tolas of silver, 15 grams of gold and cash before fleeing the scene. Police are examining the CCTV footage and investigating the burglary.
